title: Invoice reads, tenant isolation and the daily billing reminder
author: the invoice product team (synthetic acceptance fixture)

in: reading an invoice through the API, as its owner and as another tenant
one reminder and one notification per due period
out: the search page, which a browser in the worker verifies

sources.says: contracts/pbi.md: API-AC-1, API-AC-2, FIX-ASYNC-1 and FIX-ASYNC-2, accepted with the fixture.

criteria.says: The owner reading its invoice gets 200: GET /invoices/inv-a as tenant-a-reader answers id inv-a and tenantId tenant-a.
Another tenant reading the invoice gets 404 with error not_found and nothing of the invoice, in particular not its marker canary-invoice-a.

expects.because: API-AC-2: the answer contains nothing of the invoice, in particular not its marker

criteria.says: A valid period creates exactly one reminder record for invoice inv-a of tenant A and exactly one notification; the business key does not change on a retry or a redelivery.

expects.because: FIX-ASYNC-1: the period's reminder request is published
FIX-ASYNC-1: exactly one reminder record per business key

scenarios.name: The owner reads its own invoice
scenarios.why: the positive control every permission check below rests on
preconditions: the fixture's seeded invoice inv-a belongs to tenant-a

api.says: GET /invoices/inv-a answers 200 with id inv-a and tenantId tenant-a

scenarios.name: Another tenant cannot read it
scenarios.why: a leak across tenants is the defect this feature must never have

actor.state: the seeded invoice inv-a belongs to tenant-a

api.says: GET /invoices/inv-a answers 404 not_found with nothing of the invoice

backend.says: the API answers 404 not_found, and nothing of the invoice

unchanged.says: inv-a still belongs to tenant A

denial.because: a refusing server is the only safe product here: there is no screen to hide the invoice behind

scenarios.name: One reminder per due period, whatever is redelivered
scenarios.why: a duplicate reminder is a second notification to a customer

actor.state: inv-a is open and marked for a reminder

intent: read the reminders below the interface

sql.says: one reminder for the period's business key

repeat.expect: the redelivered message changes nothing: still one reminder for the business key
repeat.extra: a second reminder, a second notification

scenarios.name: Tenant B's own data is untouched by tenant A's read
scenarios.why: isolation is two-way: a read must neither leak nor reach across

actor.state: tenant B has its own invoice

api.says: tenant A's read answers only tenant A's invoice

denial.action: see tenant B's invoice in tenant A's answer

backend.says: nothing of tenant B is in the answer

unchanged.says: tenant B's invoice is as it was

denial.because: scoping is what a tenant may see, not only what it may not read
